newsitem.title: USA: Investor group has Redwood Trust stake.
newsitem.headline: Investor group has Redwood Trust stake.

text.p: New York investment advisor Richard Chilton said Wednesday that he and his entities along with other investors have acquired a total of 1,002,800 common shares of Redwood Trust Inc., or 9.1 percent of the total.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Chilton said the stock his entities hold amounts to 473,000 shares, or 4.3 percent.

But if his entities are considered a group with other entities that include Southport, Conn., investment advisor Dawson-Samberg Capital Management Inc., their combined total holdings would be 1,002,800 shares, or 9.1 percent, he said.
Chilton said a key link between his entities and the other investor groups was severed on Feb. 6 and that as a result they should no longer be considered a group under U.S. securites law.
He said he and his entities acquired their shares for investment purposes between Aug. 8, 1995 and Jan. 27, 1997 for a total of $11.8 million.
